messages:
Priya CSM: sharing a compact 'greenroom lite' checklist for go-live handoffs focused on renewal risk mitigation. Keep to 5 micro-steps so field teams can read while on a call.
Evan SRE: nice. please include a warm-probe command and a tiny health-score formula.
Priya CSM: will do. micro-steps draft: 1) preflight health, 2) run warm-probe, 3) perform 3-sample warmup, 4) enable adaptive batching+streaming defaults, 5) 30m feedback capture + escalate if needed.
Noah Eng: runtime guidance: hydration window=90s (small), 4m (med). adaptive defaults: max_batch_size=14, batch_window_ms=180, latency_slo_ms=300. limit initial concurrency to 2.
Evan SRE: probe one-liner for CS console:
```bash
# count warm replicas and tag traces for tenant
redwoodctl pools list --tenant=$TENANT --status=warm --short || echo "0"
curl -s -X POST $CONSOLE/internal/tag-traffic -d "tenant=$TENANT&tag=cs-greenroom" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```
Priya CSM: adding a simple health score we can surface on the CS dashboard:
`health = 1 - clamp(0.6*(1 - prefill_hit_rate) + 0.3*early_err_rate_norm + 0.1*latency_norm, 0, 1)`
Priya CSM: thresholds: health<0.65 => initiate escalation. early_err_rate_norm = early_err_1m / 0.01. latency_norm = median_latency_ms / 1000.
Noah Eng: fallback rule: if streaming_disconnect_rate > 0.8% for 8m, flip to non-streaming and set batch_window_ms=400; notify eng-sre.
Priya CSM: feedback card (send at T+30m):
"""
Quick check (30m): 1) Did outputs match expectations? 2) Any repeat truncations/timeouts? 3) Which single prompt should we prefill next?
Please paste any error IDs you saw so we can trace.
"""
Evan SRE: recommend header for all go-live traffic: `x-rw-cs:greenroom-<tenant>` so traces slice easily. Also add quant profile suggestion: chat -> latency-first.
cs-bot: sys: greenroom probe for tenant demo-401 completed at 2851234200 (warm_replicas=3) :white_check_mark:
Priya CSM: thanks everyone. i'll convert this into a one-pager link for field teams and add the console quick-action when Noah posts it. TL;DR for handout: "Run probe, 3-sample warmup, enable adaptive defaults, monitor health score, escalate if health<0.65, collect 30m feedback."
